prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory extension catalog in `solution.rs` using only the standard library.

Expose:
- `pub struct ExtensionDescriptor { pub id: String, pub title: String, pub revision: String, pub capabilities: Vec<String> }`
- `pub struct ExtensionInstance { pub descriptor: ExtensionDescriptor, pub serial: u64 }`
- `pub struct ExtensionFactory`
- `pub fn build_factories(records: &[&str]) -> Result<Vec<ExtensionFactory>, String>`
- Factory methods `descriptor(&self) -> &ExtensionDescriptor` and `create(&mut self) -> Result<ExtensionInstance, String>`.

Each record has exactly four `|`-separated fields: ID, title, revision, and a comma-separated capability list. Trim surrounding ASCII whitespace from every field and capability. ID, title, and revision must be nonempty. Empty capability fields produce an empty list; otherwise empty capability names are malformed. Duplicate capabilities within one record and duplicate IDs across records are errors. Titles need not be unique. Preserve record order and capability order. On any error, return no partial catalog and do not mutate the input.

A factory starts its serial counter at 1. Each successful `create` returns a cloned descriptor and the current serial, then increments it. If incrementing would overflow, that call returns an error without changing the counter.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
